metadata.title: Leo and the Shadow Thief
metadata.author: Theo Arven
metadata.description: Leo is a six-and-a-half-year-old boy with a brilliant mind and a big problem: he hates his shadow! It follows him everywhere and never says thank you. But one morning, his shadow completely disappears! Vanished, stolen by a mysterious Shadow Thief lurking in outer space. Without hesitation, Leo climbs into his Cardboard-Rocket-3000 and blasts off toward the stars to get it back. A heartwarming story of adventure, empathy, and friendship for children ages 4 to 8.

style.illustration_style: Storybook illustration for children ages 4-8, watercolor and colored pencil on textured paper, naïve warm style à la Jon Klassen and Oliver Jeffers

characters_defined.name: Leo
characters_defined.description: A small chubby 6-year-old boy with fair skin, rosy cheeks, short tousled chestnut brown hair with one rebel lock, big round black eyes.
characters_defined.clothing: A long white lab coat down to his knees, round thick black-framed glasses, bright yellow t-shirt, navy blue short shorts, bare legs, red lace-up sneakers.
characters_defined.accessories: A colander helmet (only in space) and a brass magnifying glass.
characters_defined.personality: Genius inventor, sometimes grumpy, but very brave and generous.

characters_defined.name: Shadow Thief (Nocturne)
characters_defined.description: A tiny, round, pitch-black shadow creature with glowing white expressive eyes.

metadata.title: Leo and the Star Thief
metadata.author: Theo Arven
metadata.description: One cold winter night, Leo looks out his window and notices something terrible: the stars are disappearing one by one! The night sky has turned pitch black. Leo upgrades his Cardboard Rocket into the Mk II and flies off to a frozen ice planet, where he meets a giant, shivering light-blue Yeti who took the stars just to stay warm...

metadata.title: Leo and the Time Thief
metadata.author: Theo Arven
metadata.description: Tick-Tock, the clockwork owl, has frozen Time! Clocks are spinning backward and bedtime comes too fast. For this Ultimate Bonus Collector Edition, the entire Super-Team is reunited: Leo, Barnaby the Shadow, the Blue Yeti, the Color Dragon, the Cloud Bird, and the Dream Weaver. Contains 4 bonus activity pages, a giant search-and-find game, and an official Master Inventor Diploma!
